| Manrope | 500, 600, 700, 800 | [@fontsource/manrope 5.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/manrope/v/5.3.0) | [OFL 1.1 + copyright](manrope/OFL.txt) |
| DM Sans | 400, 500, 600, 700 | [@fontsource/dm-sans 5.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/dm-sans/v/5.3.0) | [OFL 1.1 + copyright](dm-sans/OFL.txt) |
| JetBrains Mono | 400, 500, 600 | [@fontsource/jetbrains-mono 5.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/v/5.3.0) | [OFL 1.1 + copyright](jetbrains-mono/OFL.txt) |
| Share Tech Mono | 400 | [@fontsource/share-tech-mono 5.3.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource/share-tech-mono/v/5.3.0) | [OFL 1.1 + copyright](share-tech-mono/OFL.txt) |

The cockpit also uses the exact variable DM Sans Latin and Latin Extended and JetBrains Mono Latin WOFF2 faces from the locally self-hosted website; these retain the respective family notices linked above.
